_comment: Descriptive JSON-shape schema for projectile type definitions (data/projectiles/projectile_database.json) and bullet patterns (data/projectiles/bullet_patterns.json). A human-readable shape guide for validators/tooling, NOT a strict JSON-Schema document. The Rust omega-server / sim_core is the numeric authority: projectiles are spawned, stepped, and collision-resolved in the authoritative tick (positions quantized to 0.1 unit, ids assigned in band 10000-29999); the client only predicts/renders — 'the client requests, the server decides'; projectile files are a client mirror and the server wins on disagreement. Governing docs: docs/server/contract.md (wire format, PROJECTILE_FIRED, id bands, 0.1-unit quantization), docs/systems/combat-hits.md, docs/systems/abilities.md. INVARIANT: projectile ids 10000-29999. TODO: promote to formal JSON-Schema if the validators/ pipeline requires.

fields.name: string
fields.pierce: int|null — additional targets after the first (0 = single-hit)

fields.name: string
fields.type: string — spread | ring | spiral | wave | aimed_burst

invariants: projectile entity ids occupy band 10000-29999 (assigned at spawn, not in the definition)
positions/velocities are quantized to 0.1 unit (truncate toward zero) on the wire
